title.zh: 建屋发展（升级工程分区）（家居改进计划）（第 3 号）命令 2023
title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 3) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 3) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 24 May 2023.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The part of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule is declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Pasir Ris Drive 1, Pasir Ris Street 11 and Tampines Expressway, comprised in Lot number 01755T in Mukim 31 and on which Apartment Blocks 114, 115, 116 and 117 are erected, and in Lot number 01707T in Mukim 31 and on which Apartment Blocks 118, 119, 120, 121, 122, 123, 124, 125, 126, 127, 128 and 129 are erected, and which is more particularly edged in the Plan.
The PLAN
PASIR rIS STREET 11
